scope: native UD-Q3_K_M c=N decode and synchronous prompt-list continuous scheduling
source_tree: task-29 implementation and evidence are committed as one logical unit

protocol.prompt_rows: cyclically rotated fixture IDs; standard rows use the same source sequence at distinct rotations
protocol.sampling: greedy GPU row argmax; ignore EOS
protocol.prefill: resident slots are prefetched serially into disjoint state/KV while sharing one weight set
protocol.decode: all active rows advance in one native model step and one C/context-shaped HIP graph replay
protocol.throughput_units: generated target tokens per wall second

generated_ids.c2_c4_c8_512_128_vs_independent_c1: all 129 sampled IDs equal; 128 timed native decode steps

full_logits.c2_stateful_short_decode: array-exact at layer boundaries and FP32 lm-head over two steps
full_logits.c4_c8_native_rows: array-exact FP32 logits and generated IDs against independent c=1
full_logits.variable_short_prompt_rows: array-exact C=4 logits after physical slots with lengths [3,4,4,1]
full_logits.reclaim_compact_readmit: array-exact survivor and newly admitted row logits after slot 1 -> slot 0 state/KV compaction

continuous_scheduler.capacity: configurable 2..8; lists larger than capacity remain pending
continuous_scheduler.admission: free prefix slots are filled before each decode step
continuous_scheduler.completion: EOS and max-token completion reclaim scheduler ownership immediately
continuous_scheduler.compaction: persistent Conv/GDN state plus each live paged-KV prefix copy downward; transient scratch is overwritten
continuous_scheduler.readmission: new prompt prefill runs in reclaimed slots between decode steps
continuous_scheduler.sampling: row-aligned GPU argmax and per-request scheduler sampling state for the greedy-fast path
continuous_scheduler.scope_limit: This is synchronous prompt-list continuous scheduling inside one generate call, not the persistent HTTP engine loop, elastic KV pool, cancellation, or prefix-sharing destination in docs/CONCURRENCY.md.
